wildhunt.skill.storm_crown.description: Railbolt ricochets between enemies within twelve blocks through walls without revisiting a target. The initial shot needs a clear path. Thunder Step travels 16 blocks (24 Ultimate) along your aim, preserving momentum through a clear 3D path and shocks enemies along it. Toggle Storm Mantle for movement, attack speed and lightning power. Damage improves with mastery, never with EP. Master Unique skills to unlock combination Ultimates through Synthesis.
